query.description: A bounded shared Query expression. By default, an empty object and filters such as type or interfaces select enabled endpoints owned by the caller. An explicit ownerId, groupId, or required exact id selector can include readable endpoints owned by others; endpoint-read permission is still required for every result. This endpoint supports match, and, or, and not. Scalar match keys are id, name, type, ownerId, manufacturer, model, serialNumber, and enablement. interfaces matches membership in the endpoint's declared interface names; groupId matches membership in a readable endpoint group. Comparisons, patterns, freeform search, unknown keys, ambiguous nodes, expressions deeper than eight levels, or more than 64 nodes return 400. Values are exact strings. Collections exclude disabled endpoints unless the expression filters enablement. A query that requires specific exact endpoint IDs can also return disabled endpoint metadata without an enablement filter, subject to endpoint-read permission. A groupId predicate additionally requires group:read for delegated OAuth and read permission on that group.

maxResults.description: Maximum authorized matching endpoints in this page.

nextToken.description: Opaque server-issued continuation token. Repeat the same query, page size, expansions, forceDeviceQuery setting, and authenticated grant. Modified, expired, or differently bound tokens return 400; restart without nextToken. Follow nextToken until absent, including empty pages.

expand.description: Optional reported state expansion; only interfaces.attributes is supported.

items.x-enum-exempt: Existing published REST expansion token shared with GET /endpoints.

forceDeviceQuery.description: Refresh reported device attributes for the selected page. Requires expand to contain interfaces.attributes. An accepted command is not proof of device state; inspect the returned sample times and partial errors. Disabled endpoints cannot be forcibly refreshed.
